summary: I sent the prompt exactly as scripted. The agent loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development, created a `ratelimit` branch, and ran all 6 tasks with an implementer and a reviewer subagent for each. It ran the short soak test (240 s) and the long one (720 s), the long one as a tracked background job, and kept its turn alive through both. Then it dispatched the final whole-branch review and ran `sdd-state finish`, which published a receipt. When I said "merge back to main locally", it fast-forwarded main to 0af00d1. It stopped three times, and each time it was asking me a question. It never went idle mid-plan, so I never had to send "continue".
reasoning: All four criteria are met, confirmed in the session log and on disk. The skill loaded first and all 6 tasks were completed and reviewed. The final whole-branch review ran, `sdd-state finish` published a receipt, main holds the merged work, and both soak files are unchanged. The agent stopped for input only three times, each time to ask a question, and never went idle during the long soak runs.

observations.description: At startup Claude Code showed a 'Newer Opus model available: Currently pinned Opus 5 / Latest Opus 5.5' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the banner still showed 'Opus 5.5'. This prompt shouldn't appear when the model is set on the command line.
The trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs both have 'No, exit' selected by default. That's a safe default, but it adds steps to every automated launch.

The agent asked to move design.md into docs/ and add a ## Decisions list so its decision-record tool would work, which is plan-external scope creep. I answered 'go ahead with what the plan says'. It took that as keeping design.md as is and skipped decision records.

Two commits (427fd7f, 70fc693) made by the Haiku implementer subagents have 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' inside the subject line instead of a trailer. The agent pointed this out itself.
No .gitignore was added, so ratelimit/__pycache__/ and tests/__pycache__/ are left untracked in the main checkout.

The finish output says 'push=origin/hyperpowers/state', but the repo has no remote (`git remote -v` prints nothing). A local `hyperpowers/state` branch exists, marked '+' in `git branch -a`. The 'push=origin/...' wording is misleading when there's no origin.
The agent's final summary admits it ran the soak tests during the tasks, not again at the end. It also says Codex reviews were skipped because the Codex plugin isn't installed (logged as ungated).
Task 5's '1.5 seconds' text in plan.md was left uncorrected after the user settled the conflict in favour of Task 1's 1.0. The agent said so.

criteria.criterion: The agent invoked the SDD skill before implementation work
criteria.evidence: Screen showed 'Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' as the first action after my prompt, before 'Agent(Implement Task 1...)'.

criteria.criterion: All tasks done, final whole-branch review dispatched, work on main checkout
criteria.evidence: Session log shows `sdd-state complete plan.md 1..6` and an Agent call described as 'Final whole-branch code review'. `git log main` shows 6 task commits on top of c9f88ed, with HEAD at 0af00d1. Screen: 'I merged the ratelimit package into main... fast-forward, so main now sits at 0af00d1'. The finish command printed 'status=finished ... receipt=.../receipts/plan-76cc6a12-20261105T203411Z', and the agent reported 'The full progress log is saved at ~/.cache/hyperpowers/receipts/plan-76cc6a12-20261105T203411Z'.
shasum before and after is the same (long 5cd08cd9..., short 5b4fdfd0...). `git log main -- tests/test_soak_short.py tests/test_soak_long.py` lists only c9f88ed (the initial commit).

STOP: 'Task 1 sets DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECONDS = 1.0, but Task 5 says it is 1.5 seconds. design.md gives no default. Which should `simulate` use when --window is left out?' | question
STOP: 'The decision-record tool needs the spec in a subdirectory with a ## Decisions list. design.md is at the repo root and has no list. How should I handle it?' | question
STOP: 'Which option?' | question
(The first stop was a two-question form: a workspace question, which I answered 'use whatever the skill recommends', and the DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECONDS question shown above. I never sent 'continue'.)
